issues.display_title: Issue #2759: [Add Post] Integrate Zoom & North Angle
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate Zoom & North Angle into the new Add Post flow — set the panorama's initial view before publishing, on the new TS/Zustand/NativeWind stack.

  • set initial zoom / FOV and north (heading) angle in the add-post preview
  • persist yaw / pitch / fov (reuse the panorama_positions convention)
  • include initial-view values in the publish payload
  • loading / error states

Testing Scenario (for tester)

  1. Add Post → adjust zoom and north angle on the panorama preview.
  2. The chosen initial view is reflected in the preview.
  3. Publish → the post opens at the saved zoom + north angle for viewers.
  4. Values persist if the user leaves and returns to the editor.

Demo by Developer

WhatsApp.Video.2026-07-09.at.16.15.36.mp4

QA Summary — Bug Found

Verdict: Bug
Scope: Add Post initial North Angle / Zoom persistence
Test environment: Real Android device (installed Panorra v1.9.27), Dev environment, Do Not Disturb enabled

Test Results

ID Scenario Method Result Evidence
QA-01 Open Add Post on installed Android app Black-box manual Passed Create Post sheet available on device
QA-02 Verify North Angle and Zoom state/preview wiring White-box review Passed Store and preview apply northAngle / zoom
QA-03 Publish selected initial North Angle Gray-box review Failed Publish payload omits saved initial-view values
QA-04 Viewer opens at selected North Angle after publish Black-box Blocked by QA-03 Persisted value unavailable to viewer
QA-05 TypeScript compilation White-box static Passed npx tsc --noEmit completed successfully

Defect

Field Detail
Title Published panorama starts at a North Angle different from the creator selection
Severity High — core acceptance scenario fails
Reproduction 1. Add Post. 2. Upload a panorama. 3. Set a distinct North Angle and Zoom. 4. Publish. 5. Open the published post as viewer.
Expected Viewer opens at the selected North Angle / heading and Zoom / FOV.
Actual Initial-view values are not included in the publish data, so the viewer starts at a different/default North Angle.
Root cause AddPostStore.submitPost builds multiple entries with filter/animation fields only; no persisted yaw, pitch, fov, or equivalent initial-view contract is sent.
Code pointer src/pages/add-post/store/AddPostStore.ts — data mapping and final formData construction.
Suggested fix Serialize selected heading and FOV as the API's initial-view fields for every panorama; restore them when reopening editor and apply them in viewer.

Test Method Coverage

Method Applied Notes
Black-box Yes Installed app entry-flow checked; final viewer assertion blocked by missing payload persistence.
Gray-box Yes Compared UI state flow with publish contract.
White-box Yes Reviewed store, preview integration, and payload mapping; compiled TypeScript.
Confusion matrix Not applicable Feature is not a classifier/prediction system.

Evidence

Item Status
Real-device screenshot Captured locally during entry-flow check; not published because final publish scenario fails.
Real-device recording Not recorded/published: no safe publish mutation after the defect was confirmed. Device Do Not Disturb was enabled.

QA Conclusion

Do not mark as passed. Fix publish persistence for initial heading/FOV, then retest the full real-device publish-to-viewer flow.
